reviews.title: You’ve got to be kidding me. Subscription? Bring back 3!
reviews.text: I paid for paprika 3, now you automatically updated to paprika 4 with the same features that I bought under a premium subscription cost. Give me back what I paid for!

reviews.title: I used to love this app
reviews.text: I don’t know what you did with this refresh but my grocery list doesn’t put my items into the correct aisles until I go out of the app and then back in.  Definitely has glitches that need to be fixed.

reviews.title: Janky format
reviews.text:
I’ve used Paprika for years and find it incredibly useful for retaining and organizing recipes from all sources. 
Not thrilled with the new formatting changes rolled out with version 4 and no option to keep version 3.  What non-cook decided that was a good idea two weeks before Thanksgiving?

reviews.title: Are we fore real…
reviews.text: Of course they destroy the interface and now have a premium monthly subscription… honestly at this point just use AI to make a PDF with recipes and update that way.  Lesser of two evils.

reviews.title: Not happy about subscription
reviews.text: Been a LONG time paprika user and have loved this app since day 1. I paid for the app originally and have been getting all the features and now there is a subscription to unlock more features? And what I paid for is now free? I paid already and have been loyal for years. Not a fan of this price structure and respectfully, I expected better.

reviews.title: Another Great App Ruined By a Subscription
reviews.text: Paprika was great! My family and I loved it! Easy to use and no nonsense like subscriptions. Well that changed today. Features once included in the app, now locked behind a subscription. Yeah if you previously had Paprika 3 you get access to SOME of those features but not all of them, ie social media importing and calendar sync. I am getting REALLY tired of apps taking features that were included and locking them behind paywalls... Well time to find a new app.

reviews.title: Greed
reviews.text: So, you charged money for version 3 then forced version 4 on me and now you want me to pay for “premium” features? You freaking con artists!!! I want my money back or my version 3 back. Rotten!!!!!!!!!!

reviews.title: Pour One Out
reviews.text:
You either die a hero or live long enough to become the villain. Hindsight is no longer 20/20 (on a 10/10 scale) but $14.99 IAP annual sub.

BEST recipe scrapper in the business FWIW.

reviews.title: Paid App now Premium Subscription smh
reviews.text: A tale as old as time: a paid app eventually pushes a "premium subscription" model, in which new features are gated behind a subscription fee. I'm so tired apps that I paid for inevitably and eventually moving in this direction. Oh well, it seems like the old fashioned physical recipe book is the only safe bet.

reviews.title: One of my longest used apps
reviews.text: I always wondered when they would finally go subscription based, that day has come. No thanks. Deleted app.

reviews.title: Ruined
reviews.text: Changed to subscription u know why

reviews.title: devs don’t care about this app anymore, aside from any money they can get
reviews.text: The basics of the app are still nice, but if you run into a problem (which I have several times recently) you are absolutely on your own, since their FAQ isn’t necessarily updated with accurate information and no one ever responds to customer support requests. Use a free option if you can, or find a different app.

reviews.title: Siri not working on iOS 27
reviews.text: I use this feature all the time but Siri doesn’t work on iOS 27 anymore. Have to use regular siri list for grocery list. Please fix asap!

reviews.title: WHAT A WASTE OF MONEY
reviews.text: I can’t believe this is #1 in recipes. Won’t download from Facebook or Instagram. The recipes it does download from other websites are full of all sorts of jibberish that I have to cut out. Sooo much extra work compared to Recipe Keeper which is pretty seamless. I was trying to find a cheaper alternative but I guess you get what you pay for. This is just plain awful.

reviews.title: Misleading
reviews.text: You cannot download recipes that you saved on Facebook and instagram

reviews.title: Unable to download from instagram
reviews.text:
As of currently I am unable to download and or copy recipes from instagram, it throughs up error codes then forces me to “open up App Store” I looked online for fixes/ work arounds and nothing had worked for me I’ve spent roughly 2 hours trying to get this to work. 

Unless I did something wrong I wouldn’t recommend this app

reviews.title: Family recipe
reviews.text: The app is really great for recipe you find online. However, I have a lot of family recipes written that I thought I could just take a picture of and store in this app. Apparently you cannot so it’s really doing me. No good to have this.

reviews.title: No barcode scanner?
reviews.text: I should have read closer before buying. I’m not manually entering my whole pantry. I’ll probably still use for recipes but pretty disappointed the pantry feature is so basic.

reviews.title: Will not import google doc recipes
reviews.text: I have all my recipes in Google Docs. They are well formatted, but this application will not bring it in without me cutting and pasting each individual component. Waste of time.

reviews.title: Didn’t download Instagram/facebook recipes
reviews.text: Great price but you have to copy/paste internet URL into paprika.  Might as well use Pinterest for free.

reviews.title: Overrated
reviews.text: If you get most of your recipes off YouTube, as I do, Paprika is useless. It’s basically a copy and paste tool and only works if the full recipe including the instructions are written out in full otherwise it can’t capture the recipe. It’s too expensive for what it is. You’d be better off just using Copy Me That, which is free.

reviews.title: No IPhone Widget
reviews.text: The paprika guide says this app is supposed to have a widget but I’ve spent hours trying to “fix” it but still no widget. I would have never bought if I knew there wasn’t a widget.

reviews.title: Love this but lately it is struggling
reviews.text: I absolutely loveD this app for years!!  I have encouraged many others to buy it.  However, lately it struggles to download or download the information correctly. I’m not sure if an update is necessary from the developers or what.  It spins in “downloading” and I have to force quit the app. Other times it downloads it in double or leaves out information. I love this app for the ability to scroll and download great recipes. If I wanted a copy and paste version, I could have that for free.

reviews.title: Crashes Upon Opening
reviews.text: Loved it up until now. Can’t even open it.

reviews.title: Terrible organization
reviews.text: There is no way to edit or delete categories, despite the user guide saying there is. You can only add categories.

reviews.title: Nothing behind the scenes
reviews.text: I’ve had this app for a few years, I paid for the app on a Black Friday special. I’ve reach out to change my email, and cannot get anyone to reach back out! They have all sort of rules, “won’t tolerate anyone being rude to customer service” how about customer service does their job? Highly annoyed!

reviews.title: Browser doesn’t work anymore
reviews.text: I used to like this app but now I cannot get any new recipes because it redirects to google from the browser

reviews.title: Terrible
reviews.text: It has no quality of life features and the design is so basic and ugly. It’s like a free app that comes with a knock off device that feels hastily built and sketchy. I have no idea how it has 5 star reviews. Something’s fishy, this app is not good.

reviews.title: Plutôt déçu par rapport aux alternatives
reviews.text:
Prenant des recettes de multiples sources, je trouve que Paprika est dans l’incapacité à importer des recettes venant pourtant de site web ou d’Instagram. 
D’autres applications en sont pourtant capable comme Recime dans sa version gratuite. 

Plutôt déçu d’avoir payé pour cette application qui au final nécessite de rentrer manuellement la majorité des recettes que je souhaite enregistrer.

reviews.title: Would give 5 star if it allows batch import from pdfs and from safari bookmarks
reviews.text:
I just purchased it and trying the functions, so far I like the concept that you can manage recipes, meal plans, grocery shopping all in one place. A few things can improve in order of priority preferences: 1. I like that they have a native browser where dozens of recipe websites to browse but I wish they would also allow to batch import bookmarks or bookmark folders from safari, and to allow import from PDFs so it’s easy to start using the app. There is “import recipe”in the setting,  further clicking “browse” button takes to the file folder but it would not recognize any recipes saved in pdf format, so not sure what exactly can be imported. It is painful to have to navigate to 100 recipe websites which I’ve already bookmarked overtime on the phone, to be able to save them to the app. 2. For the phone app, the menu bar is hidden and requires to click the 3 lines, I wish they are permanent icons at the top or bottom of the screen for easy navigation. 3. There should be some common pantry items that you can easily browse and select so you can setup an existing pantry in a few clicks. 4. It would be great if the app comes with some existing recipes already loaded, so one can start using the app right after downloading.
Hope these can be added to future updates and I’d gradly change my rating to 5 stars.

reviews.title: App Is Deteriorating
reviews.text: Useful features in this recipe app are disappearing. A prime example is “two column printing.” This feature allowed you to put ingredients and directions on a single page. I work from a hard copy as I find a screen face is too small to easily see. I could adjust the print size and I could put the page up almost anywhere. The one page made everything visible at a glance, saved time, paper and money. I used Paprika 2 in the past and subscribed to Paprika 3 for years. I used to love it. I’m disappointed the developer isn’t fixing issues like these and not even responding to my inquiries about this. Very disappointing! Will likely transfer my recipes elsewhere and not renew the subscription when the current term expires.

reviews.title: not compatible
reviews.text: I bought the app but cannot acces it on my mac. You have to pay again to use it on other platforms. This is a scam…

reviews.title: Calendar meal export not working
reviews.text: For some reason Paprika now creates a new calendar in iOS 26.2 each time meals are exported. This is broken

reviews.title: Difficult
reviews.text: After deciding to spend money so I’m not fighting ads- now I’m spending time trying to import recipes this way and that. No thanks. Sorry I decided on Paprika

reviews.title: no ways to import recipes
reviews.text: no ways to import recipes

reviews.title: Great app … BUT…
reviews.text: This is now the third version of Paprika, which I’ve had to download. It’s a fabulous app, but every time they bring out a new version, I lose all my recipes. It’s absolutely infuriating and such a shame because it ruins a good thing.

reviews.title: Hard to import
reviews.text: Hard to directly import from instagram or TikTok. Very clunky…

reviews.title: Not useful in Canada - grocery lists imperial
reviews.text: Very disappointed I wasted money on this app, the grocery list feature is unusable as it only builds grocery lists in imperial, regardless of if you have converted the ingredients to metric. What is the point in this app if you need to get out your calculator in the grocery store for every item?

reviews.title: Could easily be so much better
reviews.text:
One has the impression of a developer resting on their laurels. Which is a shame because there is some functionality which is conspicuously missing.

- Support for websites not in English. I can't honestly believe this doesn't work but as a user I wasn't able to get French, German or Italian sites to work.

- Images are much more important to me than they are apparently to the developer. I want big thumbnails. I want a gallery of images at the very least - preferably a carousel or something. And most of all I want multiple images to be ingested automatically. Images in the present app are a total afterthought. Which is crazy because for lots of recipes step by step images are really useful.

- Play better with YouTube and instagram. Yeah the two places most people get their recipes. And yet neither is more than a crapshoot. In particular, grab the damn poster frame of videos as the thumbnail.

- I shouldn't have to categorise my recipes manually in this day and age

- features like shopping lists and menu planning are irrelevant to me. They are clutter which is nothing to do with a recipe app. Allow me to hide them please.

reviews.title: Can’t import from instagram
reviews.text: Can’t import from instagram and it’s my main source of ideas. I wish I could have tried the app without paying.

reviews.title: Import function disappointing
reviews.text:
The import doesn’t function well. It doesn’t import the description of the recipe, so I have to copy paste it.

Then in the directions it strips away the formatting, for example no more « step 1 » or paragraph delineation.

Even the formatting of the ingredients is lacking for readability.

I’m going back to using a note organizing app that does clean imports correctly.

The only mildly useful feature is the grocery list.
